applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
| Marketplace or arrangement | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Lazada, Allegro, Walmart cross-border | Same-name collection; choose the default holder for the letter. |
| Amazon, outside a stricter currency arrangement | The standard workflow offers default or other-holder letters. Match the holder and address required in the seller identity information. |
| SHEIN US collection confirmation | Company name and address must match the company licence and tax records; the account holder is the company on the licence. |
| Daraz | English-language account letter. |
| Approved AED collection | Strict same-name holder; no custom third-party letter, including manual issuance. |

Other supported platforms may offer the default or custom-holder workflow, subject to the selected currency and account restrictions. A platform offering a document-upload field does not establish that an uploaded letter has passed its review.

The account letter and a company-registry update are different records. For an unusual platform request, supply its written requirements to support.
